decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a cheap service option that builds on existing production, and it has been visible on the website for two years, so keeping it open costs little while its value is still emerging.
The seventy-two-hour express program is somewhat more costly to run, but its steady presence on the website suggests it has not yet shown its value is unlikely, so the firm keeps the option open.
The express program for doors and gates kept its own dedicated page across both years, which signals a further commitment and favourable resolution of uncertainty.
The digital ordering platform is a strategic infrastructure investment with growth options, it holds its own page, and its running costs are low relative to its potential value.
The fire and smoke protection door was upgraded from a mention to its own page in 2024, which shows positive results and further commitment, unlike the dropped fire-resistant exterior door.
